song.lyrics:
[V1] .G Am/G G Soon and very soon we are going to see the king .D D7 D/F# G G7 G6 G Soon and very soon we are going to see the king .G C/G G Em Soon and very soon we are going to see the king . Am D Am C6/D G Halleluja, Halleluja, we are going to see the king.
[V2] .G Am/G G No more crying there we are going to see the king. .D D7 D/F# G G7 G6 G No more crying there we are going to see the king .G C/G G Em No more crying there we are going to see the king . Am D Am C6/D G Halleluja, Halleluja, we are going to see the king.
[V3] .G Am/G G No more dying there we are going to see the king .D D7 D/F# G G7 G6 G No more dying there we are going to see the king .G C/G G F#dim7 Em No more dying there we are going to see the king . Am D Am C6/D G Halleluja, Halleluja, we are going to see the king.
song.title: Soon and very soon
